The '''Rebel Alliance Fleet Operations''' was a branch within the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It was primarily responsible for assigning various awards to exceptional warships.
